subject: Rename legend.title within black and white-settings

messages.author: 259bffad7213efef
messages.subject: Rename legend.title within black and white-settings
parts:
Hi,
I use the settings for black and white-fillings:
set_default_scale("colour", "discrete", "grey")
set_default_scale("fill", "discrete", "grey")
set_default_scale("colour", "continuous", "gradient",low = "white",
high = "black")
set_default_scale( "fill", "continuous", "gradient", low = "white",
high = "black")
Later on, I try to rename the legend.title with scale_fill_hue(name =
"xyz"). But then, I loose the black and white-settings. How can I
change the legend.title to "xyz" within the black and white-settings?
Kind regards
Ruedi

messages.subject: Re: Rename legend.title within black and white-settings
parts:
Hallo Babtiste,
I hope you can copy/paste it now. I want to replace "ArbeiterInnen" by
"Arbeiter/innen" without loosing black and white.
Kind regards
Ruedi

a<-c(3, 4, 4, 1, 1, 16, 23, 1)
b<-c(rep("F",4), rep("H",4))
c<-c(rep(c("a", "b", "c", "d"),2))
data<-data.frame(a,b,c)
colnames(data)<-c("Anzahl", "ArbeiterInnen", "Branche")

set_default_scale("fill", "continuous", "gradient", low = "white",
high = "black")
ep_theme <- theme_update(

axis.text.x = theme_text( family='serif', face="bold",
colour='grey50', size=11),
axis.text.y = theme_text( family='serif', face="bold",

colour='grey50', size=11),
axis.ticks = theme_blank(),

axis.title.y = theme_text( family='serif', face="bold", angle=90,
colour='grey50', size=11),

legend.text = theme_text( family='serif', size=11),
legend.title = theme_text( family='serif', face="bold", hjust=-0.03,
size=11),

legend.background = theme_rect(fill='white', colour='white', size=1),
legend.key = theme_rect(fill='white', colour='white'),
legend.position =c(0.25,0.84),

panel.grid.major = theme_line(colour='grey80'),
panel.grid.minor = theme_line(colour='grey80'))

data$Branche <- factor(data$Branche, levels = unique(data$Branche))

q<-ggplot(data, aes(x=Branche, y=Anzahl, fill=ArbeiterInnen))

r<- q + layer(
geom="bar",

position="stack"
) + scale_y_continuous("In 1000")
r
